text:
🚨 NOW: Sen. Rand Paul (R-KY) comes out in FULL SUPPORT of Donald Trump's DHS blocking immigrants who would use taxpayer-funded government welfare

"We have several hundred thousand SOMALIS in Minnesota, many of them came as refugees and about 85% percent of them that started on welfare are still on welfare!"

Multiple blue states and Mamdani have now SUED Trump for it. Slap down the lawsuit!

"It's not about coming here to join the welfare state. We actually have laws on the book that says if you come here legally you're not supposed to be eligible for a host of welfare programs for five years!"

"I would eliminate all welfare for refugees."

This is common sense. NO TAXPAYER DOLLARS to migrants. All that does is attract both "legal" and ILLEGAL foreigners to come here and siphon our tax dollars, many times through FRAUD!

@RandPaul @willcain
